answer:
| Property / Feature | Polypropylene (PP) | Urea Formaldehyde Resin (UF) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermal Classification** | Thermoplastic polymer | Thermosetting polymer |
| **Response to Heat** | Softens and melts upon heating; can be repeatedly melted and reshaped without chemical change. | Does not melt on heating; undergoes permanent chemical cross-linking during curing. |
| **Heat Resistance** | Moderate; deforms at high temperatures. | High; retains shape and strength at elevated temperatures until degradation/charring occurs. |
| **Recyclability** | Highly recyclable. | Non-recyclable due to permanent cross-linked network. |
proTip: Always use a comparison table when asked to differentiate based on thermal response (Thermoplastic vs Thermoset).
